lines.text: A holy portion of the land is set aside for the LORD, with a 500-cubit-square section for the sanctuary.
The holy strip is for the priests, and the adjacent strip belongs to the Levites for towns.
On the first day of the first month, a young goat without blemish purifies the sanctuary.
At Passover, the prince provides a sin offering for himself and all the priests of the land.
